source.text: Do not assume that creating one concept identifier establishes cognitive synonymy.
source.locator: Sections I-III, especially the definition and interchangeability discussions

reading.speaker: W. V. Quine
reading.summary: Do not assume that creating one concept identifier establishes cognitive synonymy.

review.rationale: Imported design requirement; requires source-fidelity review. Mutation control: Applying an object-language synonym substitution inside a quotation or a different compound must be flagged for review.

premises: Distinguish sameness of reference or extension from synonymy.
Distinguish stipulative definitions from claims about established usage.
Preserve quotation and compound-expression boundaries during substitution.
Treat a concept mapping as an interpretation requiring grounds, not an automatic philosophical solution.
claim.conclusion: Search over stated admissible readings, not arbitrary changes of meaning chosen solely to make the argument fail.
